clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Opens Muhammadiyah 114th Anniversary
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto officially inaugurated the Tanwir and 114th-anniversary events for Muhammadiyah in Palu.
The event featured discussions on national unity, education, health, and concerns regarding economic oligarchy in Indonesia.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Plans Selection Of New Vice President
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto confirmed he will initiate the search for a new vice president after concluding his official visits abroad.
The vacancy follows the resignation of Gibran Rakabuming from the vice presidential office.

clusters.headline: Indonesian Political Developments Following Vice President Resignation
aiSummaryBullets: The People's Consultative Assembly is currently awaiting two candidate nominations from President Prabowo for the vacant vice presidency position.
The election process to determine the next vice president is scheduled to take place in early December 2026.

clusters.headline: Foreign Minister Arrmanatha Nasir Emphasizes Unity Within ASEAN
aiSummaryBullets: Indonesian Foreign Minister Arrmanatha Nasir stressed that maintaining ASEAN unity is essential for regional stability and security.
The minister confirmed Indonesia's dedication to building resilience and cooperation within the Southeast Asian bloc.

clusters.headline: Gerindra Party Reviews Membership Status Of Kupang Regent Over Probe
aiSummaryBullets: Kupang Regent Yosef Lede faces allegations of sexual assault involving a university student at his official residence.
The NTT Regional Police are currently conducting an investigation and have begun questioning witnesses linked to the case.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Subianto Discusses Appointment Of Police Chief
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto described his selection process for National Police Chief Suyudi Ario Seto.
The President stated that he was not initially acquainted with General Suyudi Ario Seto before the appointment.

clusters.headline: Jakarta Prepares For Upcoming Performances By BTS And Guns N' Roses
aiSummaryBullets: Jakarta is set to host performances by musical groups BTS and Guns N' Roses at the GBK stadium later in 2026.
Governor Pramono Anung stated that these international events demonstrate global confidence in the city's infrastructure and status.

clusters.headline: President Prabowo Confers Honors On Forest Fire Response Personnel
aiSummaryBullets: President Prabowo Subianto awarded Bintang Jasa honors to 23 volunteers and health workers injured or killed during forest fire missions.
The government has committed to ensuring the welfare and future of the families affected by the incidents.

clusters.headline: Federasi Futsal Indonesia Chief Supports Proposed Financial Audit
aiSummaryBullets: FFI Chairman Michael Sianipar expressed support for the PSSI plan to audit the federation's non-APBN finances.
The initiative aims to examine funds sourced from entities other than the national state budget.

clusters.headline: Declan Rice Expected To Sign New Long Term Contract At Arsenal
aiSummaryBullets: Declan Rice confirmed his intention to finalize a new long-term deal with Arsenal.
The midfielder currently plays for the North London football club.
